intervals.label: DAΦNE data taking (KLOE)
intervals.locator: CERN Courier, 1 June 2018 (start); INFN-LNF particle-physics page: "formerly took data from 2000 to 2006" (end)
intervals.note: Start 1999 per CERN Courier; LNF gives 2000. End 2006 per LNF (the KLOE-2 expression of interest followed in March 2006). Year precision.
intervals.quote: which began with the first data collected by KLOE in 1999

intervals.label: KLOE data taking ended
intervals.note: Year precision. KLOE data continue to be analysed (CERN Courier).
intervals.quote: the continuation of the KLOE experiment that formerly took data from 2000 to 2006

summary.plain: The Italian and international collaboration of hundreds of physicists that built and ran the KLOE detector at Frascati's DAΦNE.
summary.technical: KLOE collaboration: hundreds of Italian and foreign physicists over the programme (CERN Courier); Paolo and Juliet Franzini, previously of CUSB at Cornell, set up KLOE at Frascati (Berkelman).
